A '''blaster fist''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] which saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The weapon would be gripped by a [[Species/Legends|being's]] [[Limb/Legends|hand]], and could be used in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]]. Blaster fists were typically constructed out of [[Steel/Legends|steel]] and [[Copper/Legends|copper]], and consisted of a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] [[Vibro-unit|unit]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Blaster fists appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
